chunks: The Commander of the Faithful, عليه السلام, used to say:

Indeed, the best means by which those seeking nearness draw near are faith in Allah and His Messenger, jihad in the way of Allah, and the word of sincerity, for it is the fitrah; establishing salat, for it is the religion; giving zakat, for it is among the obligations of Allah, Mighty and Majestic; sawm, for it is a shield from His punishment; hajj of the House, for it drives away poverty and erases sin; maintaining kinship ties, for it brings increase in wealth and delay in lifespan; secret charity, for it extinguishes sin and extinguishes the wrath of Allah, Mighty and Majestic; and acts of kindness, for they repel an evil death and protect from the falls of humiliation.

Lo, be truthful, for Allah is with the truthful. Keep away from lying, for it keeps away from faith. Lo, the truthful one stands upon the edge of salvation and honor; lo, the liar stands upon the edge of disgrace and destruction.

Lo, speak good so that you may be known by it, and act by it so that you may be among its people. Render the trust to the one who entrusted you, maintain ties with the relatives who cut you off, and return with فضل to the one who deprived you.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةِ: the obligatory alms-tax among Allah’s prescribed duties
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the prescribed salat whose establishment defines religion
key_terms.الصَّوْمُ: fasting as protection from divine punishment
key_terms.الْأَمَانَةَ: the trust that must be returned to its owner
key_terms.الْإِيمَانُ: faith in Allah and His Messenger as a primary means of nearness
key_terms.الْجِهَادُ: striving in the way of Allah
key_terms.صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ: maintaining kinship ties, a cause of blessing in wealth and life
key_terms.كَلِمَةُ الْإِخْلَاصِ: the word of pure sincerity and tawhid

ai.seo_question: What are the best means of drawing near to Allah according to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام gathers the greatest means of drawing near to Allah, combining creed, worship, and moral conduct. It also exhorts truthfulness, trustworthiness, kinship, charity, and returning goodness for harm, presenting a comprehensive path of faith and virtue.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.613 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) used to say:
"The best means by which those seeking nearness (to Allah (swt)) may draw near are;
Faith in Allah (swt) and His Messenger,
Striving in the way of Allah (swt),
Word of sincerity (testifying that there is no god but Allah (swt)), for it is the natural disposition (fitrah),
Establishing prayer for it is the religion,
Giving zakat (alms) for it is one of the obligations of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic; fasting, for it is a shield from His punishment,
Fasting as it is a shield from His punishment,
Pilgrimage to the House (Hajj), for it is a means of dispelling poverty and washing away sins,
Maintaining family ties increases wealth and prolongs life,
Charity given in secret extinguishes sin and appeases the wrath of Allah (swt) Almighty,
Acts of kindness for they repel a bad death and protect against disgraceful situations.
So, be truthful, for Allah (swt) is with the truthful. Avoid lying, for it distances one from faith. Know that the truthful one stands on the brink of salvation and honor, while the liar stands on the brink of disgrace and ruin.
Say good words so that you are recognized by them, and act upon them so that you may be among the people of virtue. Return trusts to those who have entrusted you, maintain kinship ties even with those who cut them off, and show favour to those who deprive you”.
